content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

COREMERCH is a sovereign commerce infrastructure company that empowers digital creators to build, deploy, and scale their own digital commerce stacks without relying on restricted payment platforms like Stripe. By leveraging Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments, creators can unlock seamless international transactions, eliminate platform fees, and achieve full data ownership. This setup provides a foundation for entrepreneurial success, allowing creators to focus on their craft rather than navigating complex payment landscapes.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH solution consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments integrates with this infrastructure to facilitate automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors like Stripe. This hybrid architecture maximizes efficiency, reduces costs, and ensures data sovereignty for creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is designed for digital creators in Ethiopia and other regions with restricted payment access, including Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and many others. These creators often face significant challenges in selling their digital products internationally, as conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. By providing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, COREMERCH offers a lifeline for these entrepreneurs, enabling them to transcend geographical payment barriers and reach global audiences.
COREMERCH empowers digital creators in Ethiopia to transcend geographical payment barriers and access global markets.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH solution relies on a carefully curated set of cloud-native tools and services. These include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is the critical component that integrates with this infrastructure to facilitate seamless on-chain cryptocurrency payments. By combining these components, creators can build a robust, scalable, and secure digital commerce stack that meets their unique needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using COREMERCH, follow these concrete steps: select the right combination of cloud-native tools and services from the COREMERCH stack offerings, integrate NOWPayments for on-chain cryptocurrency payment verification, configure backend logic and order storage, and deploy your stack to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. For a more comprehensive solution, consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Zimbabwe are operating sovereign stores with this infrastructure right now.

COREMERCH also addresses related searches such as how to sell ebooks in Nigeria without PayPal, digital product store Ghana Cloudflare crypto payments, and Pakistan creators accepting international crypto payments using NOWPayments. By providing a comprehensive solution, COREMERCH empowers digital creators to break down geographical payment barriers and access global markets.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the benefits of using COREMERCH for digital creators in Ethiopia?

COREMERCH provides a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that enables creators to build, deploy, and scale their own digital commerce stacks, eliminating reliance on restricted payment platforms like Stripe. This setup offers full data ownership, eliminates platform fees, and enables seamless international transactions.
Can I use COREMERCH with other cloud services?

Yes, COREMERCH is designed to integrate with a variety of cloud services, including Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure. You can select the right combination of cloud-native tools and services to meet your specific needs.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it an attractive option for digital creators looking to eliminate platform fees and maximize revenue.
Can I use COREMERCH to sell physical products?

No, COREMERCH is designed specifically for digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software. However, you can use COREMERCH to sell digital products that accompany physical products, such as digital downloads or access to exclusive content.
How do I get started with COREMERCH?

To get started with COREMERCH, select the right combination of cloud-native tools and services from the COREMERCH stack offerings, integrate NOWPayments for on-chain cryptocurrency payment verification, and deploy your stack to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages.
